prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1470; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above. Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and has retained us to pursue all available claims arising from the incident. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this firm and do not contact our client directly.

We request that you disclose the full liability and bodily injury limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any excess or umbrella coverage, and confirm the identity of the policyholder and all listed drivers. Please provide this information in writing within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle damage records, photographs, telematics and event data recorder information, claim file notes, adjuster reports, recorded statements, and any surveillance or third-party materials in your possession. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any subsequent proceeding. We look forward to your prompt written response.
